QuestInfo.0: You've cleared the Mu Long Dojo on #bNormal Mode#k. Talk to So Gong to get the #b<So Gong's Successor>#k title.
QuestInfo.1: You've cleared the Mu Long Dojo on #bNormal Mode#k. Talk to So Gong to get the #b<So Gong's Successor>#k title.

0.0: I knew the moment I saw you that Normal Mode would be too easy for you. Here, take this. Go on! This medal proves that you're worthy to be my successor. I don't just pass these out to anyone, you know.

yes.0: Don't let it get to your head too much. When you get to Lv. 120, you can attempt Hard Mode. Let's see if you can beat that.

no.0: Are you saying you're too good for me? Go on, just take it!
